d:
Pradhanmantri narendr modi bihar ko 'nitish setu' ki saugat dene ja rahe hain. is pul ke shuru hone se logon ko kitni suvidha milegi aur ilake ki kanektiviti men kya badlav aaega? dekhie nitish setu se bihar tak ki graund riport, janie pul ki khasiyat aur isse hone vale phayde.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
